title: Can Magnesium Supplements Improve Sleep, Energy and Concentration?

mock_data.title: Can Magnesium Supplements Improve Sleep, Energy and Concentration?
mock_data.passage:
In the 1600s, wealthy people in England flocked to a well on Epsom Common that was said to contain healing water. It had a bitter taste but a strong laxative effect that provided welcome relief from their rich, meat-heavy diets. "People coming there took a few glasses of the mentioned water – which has a taste different from ordinary water – after which, walking up and down, these had in our opinion very good effect," one happily unclogged visitor reported. This was later found to be due to the water's high content of the mineral magnesium sulphate, also known as Epsom salt.

Four hundred years later, magnesium's therapeutic properties are being heralded once more, and it has been called the "super mineral of the moment" in the press. On social media, I am being bombarded with posts about the supposed benefits of taking magnesium supplements, including improved sleep, energy levels, mental clarity, bowel movements and heart health, as well as reduced muscle pain, anxiety, migraines and symptoms of PMS (premenstrual syndrome). Confusingly, these supplements come in many different forms. But do they actually work?

There is no doubt that magnesium is vital to our health. It stabilises and assists the operation of hundreds of enzymes that catalyse key chemical processes in the body. It also provides stability to fundamental molecules like DNA and ATP (adenosine triphosphate), binds to various receptors and can move in and out of cells. This has earned it roles in a vast array of crucial processes including energy production in cells, nerve signalling, muscle contractions and heartbeat regulation.

Nutritionists generally advise that we try to meet our magnesium needs by eating a mix of healthy foods rather than just relying on supplements, since these foods come with additional minerals, vitamins and other nutrients. Common sources of magnesium include nuts, seeds, leafy greens, wholegrains, legumes, meat, seafood, dark chocolate and beer (some beers are more bitter than others due to extra magnesium in the brewing water). People who get ample magnesium from their diets aren't likely to benefit from taking a supplement because all the positions for magnesium in their body are already taken, meaning they will just wee the excess out.

That said, it has become trickier to get enough magnesium from food. We are eating too much processed junk, which has minimal magnesium. Plus, over-farming has depleted magnesium from our soils, so even fresh fruit, vegetables and wholegrains don't contain as much as they used to. As a result, research suggests that about 35 to 50 per cent of people in the UK, US and Australia aren't eating enough magnesium.

Some people are also more at risk of low magnesium because they have conditions like coeliac disease or Crohn's disease, which reduce its intestinal absorption, or diabetes or alcohol use disorder, which increase its excretion. When I was pregnant, I had excruciating leg cramps because pregnancy reduces magnesium levels, which makes it harder for muscles to relax after contracting. Athletes often have deficiencies too, since intense, prolonged exercise increases magnesium use and also causes it to be lost via sweating. In addition, some medications, including certain immunosuppressants and chemotherapies, are known to deplete magnesium.

Unfortunately, there is no simple test to find out if you have a magnesium deficiency. About 99 per cent of magnesium in the body is stored in the bones and soft tissues, meaning blood tests don't give a clear picture of overall magnesium levels. The gold standard test involves a magnesium infusion followed by 24 hours of urine collection, which is expensive and inconvenient. If minimal magnesium is found in the urine, it points to a deficiency because the body is eagerly sucking up the magnesium from the infusion rather than weeing it out because it already has enough.

Symptoms of magnesium deficiency include muscle soreness, tiredness, brain fog, irritability and sleep problems, but of course, many other things cause these too. This makes it easy for manufacturers of magnesium supplements to find customers.

The many kinds of magnesium supplements

Magnesium supplements come in many different forms because they contain salts of magnesium, in which the positively charged magnesium must be paired with a negative ion, which can be picked from a huge range of options. When magnesium is combined with sulphate in Epsom salt, for example, it draws extra water into the intestine to soften stools and get things moving. Magnesium oxide and magnesium citrate work the same way. Other popular supplements pair magnesium with amino acids or other organic compounds that have some shaky evidence of benefits for the brain, muscles or heart. These include magnesium glycinate, L-threonate, malate and taurate. It should be noted, however, that in the case of the amino acids in these supplements, they are also easily obtainable from a healthy diet.

Another option is to rub magnesium lotions or sprays onto the skin or soak in Epsom salt baths, but less magnesium is absorbed this way than when it is taken as an oral supplement. In fact, it is a matter of debate whether it penetrates the skin at all. This probably explains why rubbing a magnesium cream on my legs during pregnancy didn't seem to do much for my cramps. It is also unclear whether the proposed muscle relief from Epsom salt baths stems from the magnesium or simply the warm water.

I personally do not take magnesium supplements because I'm not convinced they offer anything more than a reasonable diet does, and I like food more than pills. However, there is some evidence that magnesium supplements can help with insomnia and mild anxiety in individuals who don't get enough magnesium from their diets. Likewise, there is some evidence that they can reduce muscle soreness in athletes who have greater magnesium requirements.

In contrast, there hasn't been any decent research looking at their effects on energy or concentration. Nevertheless, if you do find they help with these things, and even if it's just a placebo effect, there's no reason to stop taking them because they are considered relatively safe. Just don't overdo it like English lord Richard Evelyn, who died in 1670 after partaking too much in Epsom's waters. According to his brother, diarist John Evelyn, his demise was caused by "his drinking excessively of Epsom water when in full health and that he had no need of them".

ion.example: In magnesium salts, the positive magnesium must pair with a negative ion.
ion.definition: An atom or molecule with an electric charge due to gaining or losing electrons.
ion.exampleUzbek: Magniy tuzlarida musbat magniy manfiy ion bilan juftlanishi kerak.

ample.example: People who get ample magnesium from food don't need supplements.
ample.exampleUzbek: Ovqatdan yetarli magniy oladigan odamlarga qo'shimchalar kerak emas.

demise.example: His demise was caused by drinking too much Epsom water.
demise.definition: A person's death, or the end of something.

coeliac.exampleUzbek: Tseliakiya kasalligi bo'lgan odamlar magniy so'rishda qiyinchilikka duch kelishi mumkin.

enzymes.example: Magnesium is needed for hundreds of enzymes to function properly.

enzymes.exampleUzbek: Yuzlab fermentlarning to'g'ri ishlashi uchun magniy kerak.

legumes.example: Legumes are an excellent source of magnesium and protein.

premenstrual.exampleUzbek: Premenstrual sindrom kayfiyat o'zgarishlari, shishish va charchoqqa sabab bo'lishi mumkin.

mock_data.translation:
1600-yillarda Angliyadagi boy odamlar Epsom Common'dagi quduqqa yig'ilishdi, u shifobaxsh suv bor deb aytilardi. U achchiq ta'mga ega edi, lekin ularning boy, go'shtga boy dietalaridan xush keladigan yengillik bergan kuchli surgi ta'siriga ega edi. "U yerga kelgan odamlar eslatilgan suvdan bir necha stakan ichishdi – uning ta'mi oddiy suvdan farq qiladi – shundan keyin, u yoqqa bu yoqqa yurib, bular bizning fikrimizcha juda yaxshi ta'sir ko'rsatdi," deb xabar berdi bir baxtli tashrif buyuruvchi. Keyinchalik bu suvning mineral magniy sulfat, Epsom tuzi deb ham ataladigan yuqori tarkibi tufayli ekanligi aniqlandi.

To'rt yuz yil o'tib, magniyning terapevtik xususiyatlari yana bir bor e'lon qilinmoqda va u matbuotda "hozirgi zamonning super minerali" deb atalgan. Ijtimoiy tarmoqlarda men magniy qo'shimchalari qabul qilishning go'yoki foydalari – yaxshilangan uyqu, energiya darajalari, aqliy ravshanlik, ichak harakatlari va yurak salomatligi, shuningdek kamaytirilgan mushak og'rig'i, tashvish, migren va PMS (premenstrual sindrom) alomatlari haqida postlar bilan bombardimon qilinmoqdaman. Chalkashtiradigan narsa shundaki, bu qo'shimchalar ko'p turli shakllarda keladi. Lekin ular haqiqatan ham ishlaydimi?

Magniy sog'lig'imiz uchun hayotiy muhim ekanligiga shubha yo'q. U tanadagi asosiy kimyoviy jarayonlarni katalizlaydigan yuzlab fermentlarning ishlashini barqarorlashtiradi va yordam beradi. U, shuningdek, DNK va ATF (adenozin trifosfat) kabi fundamental molekulalarga barqarorlik beradi, turli retseptorlarga bog'lanadi va hujayralar ichiga va tashqarisiga harakat qilishi mumkin. Bu unga hujayralardagi energiya ishlab chiqarish, asab signallari, mushak qisqarishlari va yurak urishi tartibga solinishi kabi juda muhim jarayonlarda rollar berdi.

Dietologlar odatda magniy ehtiyojlarimizni faqat qo'shimchalarga tayanish o'rniga turli sog'lom ovqatlar yeb qondirishga harakat qilishimizni maslahat berishadi, chunki bu ovqatlar qo'shimcha minerallar, vitaminlar va boshqa ozuqa moddalari bilan birga keladi. Magniyning keng tarqalgan manbalari orasida yong'oqlar, urug'lar, bargli ko'katlar, butun donlar, dukkaklilar, go'sht, dengiz mahsulotlari, qora shokolad va pivo bor (ba'zi pivolar pishirish suvidagi qo'shimcha magniy tufayli boshqalardan ko'ra achchiqroq). Dietasidan yetarli magniy oladigan odamlar qo'shimcha qabul qilishdan foyda olish ehtimoli kam, chunki ularning tanasidagi magniy uchun barcha o'rinlar allaqachon band, ya'ni ular ortiqchasini shunchaki siydik orqali chiqaradi.

Shunday bo'lsa-da, ovqatdan yetarli magniy olish qiyinlashdi. Biz juda ko'p qayta ishlangan keraksiz ovqat yeyapmiz, unda magniy minimal. Bundan tashqari, haddan tashqari dehqonchilik tuproqlarimizdan magniyni kamaytirdi, shuning uchun hatto yangi mevalar, sabzavotlar va butun donlar ham ilgari bo'lgandek ko'p miqdorda magniy o'z ichiga olmaydi. Natijada, tadqiqotlar Buyuk Britaniya, AQSh va Avstraliyadagi odamlarning taxminan 35 dan 50 foizigacha yetarli magniy yemayotganini ko'rsatadi.

Ba'zi odamlar ham past magniy xavfi ostida, chunki ularda tseliakiya kasalligi yoki Kron kasalligi kabi holatlar bor, bu uning ichak orqali so'rilishini kamaytiradi, yoki diabet yoki alkogol iste'mol buzilishi, bu uning chiqarilishini oshiradi. Men homilador bo'lganimda, homiladorlik magniy darajasini pasaytirishi sababli dahshatli oyoq qisqichlari bo'lgan, bu mushaklar qisqargandan keyin bo'shashishini qiyinlashtiradi. Sportchilar ham ko'pincha tanqislikka ega, chunki shiddatli, uzoq muddatli jismoniy mashqlar magniy iste'molini oshiradi va terga chiqarish orqali ham yo'qotiladi. Bundan tashqari, ba'zi dorilar, jumladan ba'zi immunosuppressantlar va kimyoterapiyalar magniyni kamaytirgani ma'lum.

Afsuski, magniy tanqisligi bor yoki yo'qligini aniqlash uchun oddiy test yo'q. Tanadagi magniyning taxminan 99 foizi suyaklar va yumshoq to'qimalarda saqlanadi, ya'ni qon testlari umumiy magniy darajasi haqida aniq tasavvur bermaydi. Oltin standart test magniy infuziyasini, keyin esa 24 soatlik siydik yig'ishni o'z ichiga oladi, bu qimmat va noqulay. Agar siydikda minimal magniy topilsa, bu tanqislikka ishora qiladi, chunki tana allaqachon yetarli bo'lgani uchun chiqarish o'rniga infuziyadan magniyni ishtiyoq bilan so'rib olmoqda.

Magniy tanqisligi alomatlari mushak og'rig'i, charchoq, miyaning lohiligi, asabiylik va uyqu muammolarini o'z ichiga oladi, lekin albatta, boshqa ko'p narsalar ham shularni keltirib chiqaradi. Bu magniy qo'shimchalari ishlab chiqaruvchilari uchun mijozlar topishni osonlashtiradi.

Magniy qo'shimchalarining ko'p turlari

Magniy qo'shimchalari ko'p turli shakllarda keladi, chunki ular magniy tuzlarini o'z ichiga oladi, bunda musbat zaryadlangan magniy manfiy ion bilan juftlanishi kerak, uni juda keng tanlov orasidan tanlash mumkin. Magniy Epsom tuzida sulfat bilan birlashtirilganda, masalan, u ichakka qo'shimcha suv tortib, axlatni yumshatadi va narsalarni harakatga keltiradi. Magniy oksid va magniy sitrat xuddi shunday ishlaydi. Boshqa mashhur qo'shimchalar magniyni aminokislotalar yoki miya, mushaklar yoki yurak uchun foydasi haqida ba'zi ishonchsiz dalillarga ega boshqa organik birikmalar bilan juftlaydi. Bularga magniy glitinat, L-treonat, malat va taurat kiradi. Biroq, shuni ta'kidlash kerakki, bu qo'shimchalardagi aminokislotalar holatida ular sog'lom dietadan ham osonlikcha olish mumkin.

Yana bir variant – magniy losyon yoki spreylari teriga surtish yoki Epsom tuzli vannada cho'milish, lekin bu usulda og'iz orqali qo'shimcha sifatida qabul qilingandagidan kamroq magniy so'riladi. Aslida, u teriga singib kiradimi yoki yo'qmi – bu munozara mavzusi. Bu ehtimol homiladorlik paytida oyoqlarimga magniy kremi surish qisqichlarim uchun unchalik yordam bermaganini tushuntiradi. Epsom tuzi vannasidagi taklif qilingan mushak yengillatishi magniydan keladimi yoki shunchaki iliq suvdan keladimi – bu ham noaniq.

Men shaxsan magniy qo'shimchalari qabul qilmayman, chunki ular oqilona dietadan ko'proq narsa taklif qilishiga ishonmayman va men tabletkalardan ko'ra ovqatni yaxshi ko'raman. Biroq, dietasidan yetarli magniy olmaydiganlar uchun magniy qo'shimchalari uyqusizlik va engil tashvishga yordam berishi mumkinligi haqida ba'zi dalillar mavjud. Xuddi shunday, magniy talablari kattaroq bo'lgan sportchilarda mushak og'rig'ini kamaytirishi mumkinligi haqida ba'zi dalillar bor.

Aksincha, ularning energiya yoki diqqatga ta'siri bo'yicha hech qanday munosib tadqiqot o'tkazilmagan. Shunga qaramay, agar siz ular bu narsalarga yordam berishini aniqlasangiz va bu faqat plasebo ta'siri bo'lsa ham, ularni qabul qilishni to'xtatish uchun hech qanday sabab yo'q, chunki ular nisbatan xavfsiz hisoblanadi. Faqat 1670-yilda Epsom suvlaridan haddan tashqari ko'p iste'mol qilib vafot etgan ingliz lordi Richard Evelindek oshirib yubormang. Uning ukasi, kundalik yozuvchi Jon Evelin so'zlariga ko'ra, uning o'limi "to'la sog'lom paytida va ularga hech qanday ehtiyoji yo'q bo'lganida Epsom suvini haddan tashqari ichishi" sababli bo'lgan.
